name: Baccarat Rouge 540
description: Baccarat Rouge 540 is a luminous, crystal-clear fragrance created in 2015 to celebrate the 250th anniversary of Maison Baccarat. Francis Kurkdjian designed this scent to embody the brightness and warmth of crystal catching light. It has become one of the most coveted and recognizable niche fragrances in the world, admired for its unique, almost ethereal quality.
